_comment: add-vehicle-and-building-damage. A drivable car's health is 100. A crash closing faster than crash_min_mps (m/s) loses crash_per_mps for each m/s over it (60 km/h into a wall: about 32); weapon hits lose combat_config.json's vehicle_damage for their impact kind. Stages by health: scuffed below scuffed_below, dented below dented_below, smoking below smoking_below (pull and top speed times smoking_power), wrecked at 0. A hit of dent_min or more leaves a dent dent_depth_per_damage m deep per point (at most dent_max_m, max_dents kept, dent_radius_m wide). A burning wreck catches fire burn_after_s after it was wrecked, explodes explode_after_s later, and its shell burns for shell_burn_s. The blast reaches blast_radius_m: vehicles get up to blast_impulse N·s and blast_car_damage health, the player up to blast_player_damage, all falling to none at the edge.
